apps.localizedDescription: Development SideStore build with on-device Apple Watch companion install (issue #229). Installs embedded Watch apps to the paired watch via companion_proxy + streaming_zip_conduit. Includes crash-durable watch-install breadcrumb logging.

versions.localizedDescription: fix229-build12: SECOND phone/watch pair fix. A provisioning profile is a device whitelist — sign-in registered only the iPhone, and the paired watch's UDID was read from companion_proxy ~3s AFTER the watch profile had already been downloaded. Apple therefore issued a watchOS-platform profile that did not list the watch, and watchOS installd rejected the app at 40% VerifyingApplication with 0xe8008015 (ApplicationVerificationFailed). Now the companion_proxy device registry is queried BEFORE provisioning a watch bundle, and every paired watch is registered on the team as a watchOS-type device (DTDK_Platform=watchos). Non-fatal by design: no watch, no companion_proxy, or a device-limit refusal cannot regress the iPhone install. Swift-only — no FFI change. Look for 'Paired watch UDID(s)' + 'as watchOS device on team' in the log before the deviceType 16 profile fetch.

fix229-build11: root-cause fix. lockdownd_pair was declared in the FFI header but never linked into the library (missing default feature) — every prior crash was calling a phantom symbol regardless of Swift-side fixes. Fixed upstream (idevice v0.1.68-ss-cp229e). This should reach the watch Trust prompt.

fix229-build10-debug (SideStore 869f87d3 / minimuxer 0e365198): crash-durable watch-install breadcrumb. Reinstall PadelScorer, let it crash, relaunch SideStore, export log — look for [WatchInstall][prev] lines.
